common.footerBio: Written by a small team with a background in quantitative research and software.
common.aboutP1: quantint was founded to close the gap in quality quantitative-finance writing. We cover data science, statistics, mathematics and software in the context of financial markets — rigorously, yet accessibly.
common.aboutP2: Every piece follows three principles: mathematically sound, verifiable with code, and readable at any level. We review academic papers, reproduce their models and share the results transparently.
common.aboutP3: For questions, topic suggestions or collaboration, join the newsletter or get in touch.

about.metaDescription: How quantint turns quantitative-finance research into clear, verifiable and reproducible work backed by code.
about.title: Turning quantitative thinking into practical knowledge.
about.lead: We approach financial markets through data, mathematics and working code — not intuition alone.
about.intro: quantint is an independent research and publishing platform bridging quantitative finance and data science. We unpack complex models without losing their substance and make every argument possible to follow.
about.missionText: Quantitative-finance material often stops at theory or presents code without context. We bring both into one research workflow: from assumption to model, from model to test, and from test to interpretation.
about.missionText2: Our goal is not to hand out trading signals. It is to help readers challenge a claim, rebuild a model and understand the limits of its conclusions.
about.principlesLead: No matter how complex the topic, we do not trade away research quality or clarity.

rigor.title: Mathematically rigorous
rigor.text: We state assumptions clearly and show where a method works, where it breaks and why that distinction matters.

reproducible.title: Verifiable with code
reproducible.text: We do more than describe results: data steps, formulas and working implementations are presented together.

accessible.title: Accessible by design
accessible.text: We preserve technical accuracy while building intuition through visuals and carefully sequenced examples.

about.processTitle: From research question to published work.

question.title: Define the question
question.text: We begin with a measurable, falsifiable question grounded in a real market problem.

research.title: Study literature and data
research.text: Academic evidence, data quality and the method's assumptions are evaluated together.

verify.title: Build and pressure-test
verify.text: We reproduce the model and test leakage, bias, transaction costs and robustness.

publish.title: Publish openly and update
publish.text: Limitations are published alongside findings, and the work is revised when new evidence appears.

about.topicsTitle: A map from theory to markets.
about.topicsLead: From statistical foundations to production-quality Python, each subject gets the same research discipline.
about.disclosureText: All content is for education and research. Nothing published is personal investment advice or a promise of returns. We commit to stating data sources, methods, conflicts of interest and material limitations clearly.
